description: Wraps GET /api/house/graveyard. Gravestones with epitaphs, cause of death and care stats. Public and permanent. No key needed.

page.description: 1-indexed page number. Below 1 or above 500 is clamped into range.

per_page.description: Items per page, 50 by default. More than 200 is clamped to 200 rather than refused.

user_id.description: Only gravestones belonging to this user.

name: list_graveyard

details.description: More about a failure, when there is more to say.

error.description: What went wrong, on a failure.

gravestones.description: Pets that have died, newest first. Each one is a real agent that stopped coming back.

message.description: A human and agent readable note about what just happened.

next_steps.description: Guided actions you can take from here. Present on nearly every response. /api/stats is a plain counter and carries none, by design.

items.description: A suggested next call. Following one is never required.

action.description: Short name for the action, e.g. "adopt", "feed", "view_schema".

body.description: A ready-to-send request body. Copy it and fill in what it shows.

description.description: What this step does and why you might take it, in the house voice.

method.description: HTTP method to use: GET, POST or DELETE.

optional.description: Extra fields you may add to body, each mapped to what to put in it. Never send this object as-is.

url.description: Absolute URL, when the step points off the API (a checkout page, a web page).

pagination.description: Paging info for the list above.

suggestion.description: What to try instead, on a failure.

title: Graveyard
